hold_policy.scope: contiguous true SAVED observations, not continuous path certification
hold_policy.review_gray_band: 1e-10 around the exact rational tolerance boundary; gray cases not conformance passes

events.held: first saved onset of any fully observed qualifying true run
events.held_retention: initial true run qualifies; not a claim of retention forever
events.held_recovery: first qualifying true run after the first False saved observation, including False at index0
events.held_classification: exclusive trajectory label; retention takes precedence over recovery

time_roles.event_time_for_held_rows: retrospective run-onset timestamp relative to the branch origin
time_roles.confirmation: first later saved sample satisfying the hold-span policy; requires future observations
time_roles.adjacent_interval_fields: sampling metadata only; not an identified first-physical-crossing interval without assumptions
time_roles.first_saved_retention: index0 means true at first saved time0.01; behavior before that is not reconstructed

population_and_cap.reported_event_rate_denominator: all40 supplied seeds, including never-dropped seeds
population_and_cap.alternative_ever_dropped_denominator: descriptive alternative only; post-treatment selection is not a default causal repair
population_and_cap.last_eligible_onset: last saved onset whose duration can finish by the support end; depends on duration/rho
population_and_cap.comparison_warning: an always-retained reference can have NO recovery event and receive the cap; a lower recovery score is not automatically better overall resilience

inference.conditional_raw_DID: same seed has all four cell events; not merely each branch has some events

limits: no run_analysis artifact/provenance or atomic-output acceptance audit
no Lean compilation or coupled dynamics result
outside source/synthetic review is not project freeze or registry approval
